parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Require an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to ensure SMILES presence. Filter by target CHEMBL5251 and standard_type IC50. Include only rows where docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi is not null. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
